response.overview: CreatorSMP Hardcore Season 4 is a Minecraft survival event featuring 90 Dutch-speaking content creators who must survive together in a massive hardcore world for three weeks. With only one life, every fight, alliance and decision could determine who makes it to the final showdown. The world is divided into two territories, North and South, separated by a gigantic wall filled with mysterious mazes, hidden secrets and dangerous challenges. As rivalries grow and players begin to turn against one another, eliminated contestants get a second chance in the mysterious Losers’ Realm, where they must fight for the opportunity to return. In the end, only one creator can survive and claim the title of CreatorSMP champion.
response.tagline: “90 creators. One life. One world. Only one survivor.”
response.title: CreatorSMP Hardcore Season 4
